watch.summary: Following chat's advice to jump on a block, the creator's egg character is violently launched into the air by glitchy physics and smashes on impact.

beats.what: The creator counts down and jumps onto the designated wooden block.
The block catches the egg and launches it uncontrollably upward.
The creator repeatedly screams 'Ayo!' in panic as his egg spins through the air.
The egg crashes onto a wooden plank and cracks open.
The creator laughs in disbelief at what just happened.

watch.author: mixed
watch.why: The instant visual chaos caused by erratic physics creates an easy slapstick punchline. The creator's frantic verbal panic builds hilarious tension right up until the egg shatters.
